assessment: The risk c-0004.1 named yesterday has stopped being a risk and started showing up in the machine state. Nothing broke - no assertion failed, no job errored, 0 blocking and 0 unverified - but the gate went amber overnight for the two reasons that follow from a build nobody is touching: all seven contract tests are now stale because no session has run the suite in thirty-nine hours, and the evening harvest went late after its 20:30 tick and has missed three of its last five. Four items now sit on Andrew, two of them past forty hours, and the two that would end the stall - c-0001.4 and c-0003.1 - each need about a minute of his attention: one answer about how the top-5 list is actually traded, and one shell on zoltarlead so this heartbeat can seal and validate its own cycles instead of typing them for a fifth consecutive fire.

items.title: Diagnose the evening harvest, which stopped after its 20:30 tick and has missed 3 of its last 5 windows
items.why: The evening harvest is the only capture of the AFTERCLOSE UPDATE full retrain, and that vintage is load-bearing twice over: H11's entire population is the evening retrains, and the 2026-09-02 stamp-convention cutover makes the rows on either side of it the thing stamp_cutover exists to keep unpooled. A silent gap in this feed does not announce itself later - it shows up as a thinner n and a shifted MDE that nobody can attribute, which is the same class of error as the placeholder pointer: evidence quietly replaced by an artefact of collection. Three misses in five ticks is a pattern, not one bad night, so this needs a cause rather than a restart. It is not a phase step, which is why it is not displacing anything from now; but it is the input every phase downstream is measured on, and unlike the queue stall it degrades the archive rather than just delaying it.
items.acceptance: The cause is recorded in docs/FINDINGS.md or the session log (schedule window, scheduled-task state, upstream availability, or exception - named, not guessed), and data/results/build_status.json shows harvest_evening back to status healthy with a last_run_at inside the 2026-09-04 15:30-21:30 CDT window. For the 2026-09-03 21:00 and 21:30 windows specifically: either the rows are backfilled and the run count reconciles, or FINDINGS records what was lost and why it was not recoverable - an unexplained gap is not an acceptable close.
